# S349 — Retry of a stopped run skips the implementer and goes straight to checks and the gate

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer s453, ork-20261111-213809-376f): the run paused after round 3 with the gate's one [fix] open (a denied git mv). After the run was stopped, the allow added, and `ork retry RUN --rounds 2`, round 4 ran checks and the gate only (no implementer-4 report); the gate failed on the same [fix] and the run stopped at 3 gate fails. The help says a stopped run resumes 'with N more implementer rounds'. Wanted: the retry starts with an implementer fix round carrying the open [fix] findings.
